text: In the one day since the last run (10 November), beauty again gained by far the most new reviews (about 10,900), led by a ₹138 Wildplay perfume (+1,723), while outside beauty the fastest movers were a ₹184 baby girl dress (+734), a ₹128 Dabur Red toothpaste combo (+657) and a ₹91 fridge cover (+418). For a beginner, home & kitchen and jewellery still look best, with kids' toys and bags close behind.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurtis lead, Banarasi sarees keep arriving for wedding season
text: Kurtis still have the most reviews, and in the day since the last run a ₹303 woven Banarasi jacquard saree (+103), a ₹237 kurti (+83) and a ₹410 anarkali kurti set (+83) gained the most, with the category adding about 1,200 new reviews. Eight listings are new to the page, mostly Banarasi silk, georgette and jacquard sarees, which fits the wedding season running through November and December. The typical price is about ₹298, but about 9.3% of reviews are 1-star, likely because of colour, fabric and size complaints. Most sellers are in Gujarat (24 of 40) and Rajasthan (11), so competition from Surat and Jaipur is heavy, and sizes make kurtis risky for a beginner.

headline: Women's western: shirts and tank tops lead, jackets rise with winter
text: A ₹194 women's shirt gained the most reviews since the last run (+103), followed by a ₹294 girls' jacket (+89) and a ₹310 three-piece graphic top set (+78), and the category added about 1,200 new reviews. New to the page are two women's jackets, a rib knit tank top and a pack of two high neck tops, so winter layers keep picking up. The typical price is about ₹286 with about 8.7% 1-star reviews. Half the sellers are in Delhi (20 of 39); sizes and fit complaints make this a medium choice for a beginner.

headline: Men's clothing: slowest category again, formal shirts move and hoodies arrive
text: Men's clothing gained the fewest new reviews again, only about 425 in a day, mostly on formal shirts around ₹390, led by one at ₹395 (+122). Hoodies, zipper sweatshirts and a winter sweater are new or rising on the page, but they have only a few hundred to about 1,500 reviews so far. About 11.9% of reviews are 1-star, the highest of any category, likely because of fit and fabric complaints. Sellers are spread across Rajasthan, Punjab and Delhi; with sizes and high complaints this stays hard for a beginner.

headline: Kids & toys: cheap clothing sets surge, winter wear and play tents arrive
text: Kids gained about 2,700 new reviews in a day, led by a ₹184 baby girl dress (+734), a ₹182 three-pack cat print set (+189), a ₹203 kids' sweater set (+147) and a ₹189 boys' set (+135). New and rising are a ₹171 wool thermal set, a ₹306 pretend-play donut shop tent and a baby gym mat. The typical price is the lowest of the clothing categories at about ₹189, with about 8.9% 1-star reviews. Clothing needs sizes, so for a beginner the toys (puzzles, soft toys, toy vehicles) are the easier side, especially ahead of Children's Day on 14 November and Christmas.

headline: Home & kitchen: fridge covers and cotton wicks are the fastest movers
text: A ₹91 fridge cover gained the most reviews since the last run (+418), followed by ₹98 handmade cotton wicks (+306), a ₹367 collapsible shoe rack (+105) and a ₹167 crystal LED lamp (+74), and the category added about 1,100 new reviews. New to the page are a kitchen runner doormat set, a steel cup stand, a biryani handi and tea strainer sets. The typical price is the lowest of any category at about ₹155 and only about 7.7% of reviews are 1-star. Sellers are spread across Gujarat, Delhi and Madhya Pradesh, and these light, no-size items are the best fit for a beginner; diyas and puja items may slow after Diwali, but Dev Deepawali and the wedding season are still ahead.

headline: Beauty: cheap perfumes lead again, but big brands dominate
text: Beauty gained about 10,900 new reviews in a day, far more than any other category. A ₹138 Wildplay perfume (+1,723), a ₹296 Ghar Soaps de-tan face wash (+1,053), a ₹149 French Essence body spray (+903) and a ₹226 Mamaearth face wash (+864) moved most, and Gillette shaving foam and Veet hair removal cream are new to the page. Most top products are brands such as Ghar Soaps, Muuchstac, Mamaearth, Gillette and Vaseline, which usually need brand approval to sell. The typical price is about ₹199 with about 8.5% 1-star reviews; demand is huge, but a beginner without a brand licence will find it hard to compete.

headline: Jewellery: light, cheap and in the middle of wedding season
text: A ₹92 pearl necklace back rope gained the most reviews since the last run (+80), followed by a ₹151 golden bracelet (+79) and a ₹163 silver plated American diamond set (+67), and the category added about 540 new reviews. Eight listings are new, mostly kundan and pearl jewellery sets, and a ₹243 chunky mangalsutra and a ₹148 four-piece combo are rising fast, which fits the wedding season through December. The typical price is about ₹180 with about 8% 1-star reviews. Sellers are mainly in Maharashtra (13) and Gujarat (10); jewellery is light, has no sizes and needs no brand licence, so it remains one of the best beginner choices.

headline: Bags & footwear: sling bags and totes lead, shoes need sizes
text: Handbags have the most reviews, and a ₹151 sling bag (+57), a ₹186 shoulder bag (+52), a ₹251 handbag (+47) and a ₹166 printed tote (+45) gained the most in a day, with the category adding about 880 new reviews. New to the page are sneakers, women's boots and slipper packs, and ₹148 ethnic flat sandals jumped to the top of the footwear list. The typical price is about ₹206 with about 7.2% 1-star reviews, among the lowest. Most sellers are in Delhi (25 of 40); bags are a good beginner fit because they have no sizes, while footwear does.

headline: Electronics accessories: speakers lead, high complaint rate
text: Bluetooth speakers and phone holders have the most reviews, and a ₹382 wooden speaker (+130), an ₹84 phone stand two-pack (+84) and a ₹282 speaker (+69) gained the most in a day, with about 750 new reviews in all. New and rising are wall-mount phone holders, a ₹186 selfie stick tripod and 'AirPods Pro' style earbuds, which carry brand-copy risk. The typical price is the highest of any category at about ₹325, and about 11.6% of reviews are 1-star, second only to men's clothing. Sellers are split between Gujarat, Delhi and Haryana; simple phone stands are the only beginner-friendly part, while gadgets bring returns and complaints.

headline: Health & fitness: brands lead pads, ear patches and ear cleaners are the easy picks
text: Health gained about 3,000 new reviews in a day, second only to beauty, led by a ₹128 Dabur Red toothpaste combo (+657), an ₹88 ear wax cleaner kit (+458), ₹68 earlobe support patches (+259) and Stayfree pads (+243). New and rising are a ₹100 bamboo toothbrush, a ₹244 rubber football and badminton rackets. The typical price is about ₹237, and at about 5.5% 1-star reviews this is the lowest complaint rate of any category. Pads and toothpaste are big brands, so a beginner should look at the unbranded items like earlobe patches, ear cleaners and sports gear; sellers are spread across Uttar Pradesh, Delhi and Punjab.

headline: Wall shelves: steady seller, small numbers, a wall phone holder jumps to the top
text: Only 20 products were read from this single list, and they gained about 270 new reviews since the last run, led by a ₹351 wooden TV-unit wall shelf (+102) and a ₹313 plain wooden shelf (+26). The new top listing is a ₹91 wall-mounted mobile and remote holder with about 27,400 reviews, which pulls the typical price down to about ₹218 (it was about ₹284 yesterday); proper shelves still sell around ₹130 to ₹350. About 7.3% of reviews are 1-star, which is low, and most sellers are in Uttar Pradesh (10) and Rajasthan (7). Demand is real but modest compared with jewellery or kitchen items, and shelves are bulkier to ship, so treat this as a medium choice: small decorative shelves around ₹130 to ₹150 are the lightest way in.

Fridge covers around ₹90 to ₹100 (home & kitchen, fastest mover again)
American diamond and kundan jewellery sets around ₹140 to ₹250 (wedding season)
Sling bags and printed tote bags around ₹150 to ₹190
Small kitchen tools such as cup stands, tea strainers and runner doormats around ₹130 to ₹200
Invisible earlobe patches and ear cleaning kits around ₹70 to ₹90
Simple kids' toys and play tents around ₹200 to ₹300 (Children's Day and Christmas)

Avoid for now: men's shirts (slowest growth and 11.9% 1-star reviews), earbuds and speakers (high complaint rate and copy-brand risk), branded beauty and sanitary products that need brand approval, and size-heavy clothing like sarees and kurtis with 9%+ 1-star reviews.
